description: Serial regression controls for explicit comparison and universe-level traversals. Budgets, fixtures, library and frontend sources are unchanged.
method: Before then after, three serial timing pairs on the same macOS arm64 host. Each timing invocation loads one WASM module and uses fresh programs. Fixed normalization probes ran separately. Timings include imports and checking; arena capacity excludes temporary worklists. No portable timing threshold or speedup claim.
